text:
maria: Hey team — opened PR #9721 to change header forwarding for toolcall + streaming client. Can someone take a quick pass? Affects js/ts and go clients.
kevin: I'll try to look today. rough diff size?
maria: ~120 LOC, major change is in header dedupe + order. Also added a compat shim for old token header. repro snippet:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/client/toolcall \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Client: js-sdk/1.2.0" \
  -d '{"tool":"search","input":"hi"}'
```
olivia: Important: keep previous header order for some enterprise proxies. Add unit test and an integration fixture.
ci-bot: build failed on windows-integration: tests/stream-header-dedupe timed out (flaky)
sanjeev: left a comment in the PR re: server side header-normalization — otherwise small nits.
maria: pushed a fix to preserve ordering and added test and a changelog entry. Re-ran CI.
ci-bot: linux-integration: passed. windows-integration: still flaky (retrying)
kevin: taking a look now. quick note: prefer `normalizeHeaders` name for the helper; clearer intent.
maria: done, renamed helper and addressed comments. PTAL.
kevin: LGTM modulo keeping one more assertion in the new test to ensure old behavior. I'll add it in a follow-up if that's ok.
merge-bot: PR #9721 labeled ready-for-merge after 2 approvals.
maria: Thanks all — merging once windows job stabilizes. :pray:
